name: whip-desk
description: ClaudeWhip for Claude Desktop: the whip lane as a band above the prompt, hit toasts, slap buttons and a stats pane

show.title: Show the whip band and toasts
show.description: Off hides ClaudeWhip in this app completely. The ✕ on the band hides it too; /whip-desk-show brings it back.

sound.title: Whip crack sound
sound.description: on / off writes `sound` in ~/.claude/whip/config.json; 'whip config' leaves whatever `whip config set sound` chose.

voice.title: Claude yelps out loud
voice.description: on / off writes `voice` in ~/.claude/whip/config.json; 'whip config' leaves it as it is.

terminalBand.title: Also draw the band in the terminal
terminalBand.description: Off by default: the terminal already shows the whip lane in its status line.
